site_assignment_evidence: Bowtie alignments against chromosomes and splice junctions were converted to wiggle files in the genomic coordinate space of Drosophia melanogaster genome build dm3.  In this stage, each read was counted once. For the mRNA samples  the entire length of each read alignment was used (i.e. the genomic positions corresponding to the entire alignment were each incremented by 1/alignment_length, so that each alignment is counted once), for the ribosome footprints samples the caculated postion of the ribosome P-site was used. Scores therefore represent the number of read alignments attributed to each genomic position under each scoring scheme.

utr_cds_and_site_protocol.reason: GEO/source papers expose heterogeneous processed assignments and genome builds; public reads make a new protocol feasible but do not validate a universal offset or recreate UTR annotations.

conclusion: Public raw sources are recoverable at runinfo level and the pinned VeloHARMO mirror contains only the Ecoli harmonized matrix; four other organisms have public source studies but no released harmonized matrix in that snapshot. UTR-CDS mapping and independent P-site remapping remain feasible future protocols, not completed evidence.
